walkthroughs.body_html: Cardiac output (Q) = stroke volume × heart rate. Resting: SV 70 ml × HR 70 bpm = 4900 ml/min ≈ 5 L/min. During hard exercise it can reach 20-30 L/min in trained athletes.

The body has a double circulation:

  • Pulmonary — right side of heart to lungs and back.
  • Systemic — left side of heart to body and back.

Blood passes through the heart twice per full circuit.

During exercise, vasodilation in arterioles supplying muscles increases blood flow there. Vasoconstriction reduces blood to organs like the gut. This vascular shunt delivers more oxygen to where it's needed.
